title: Making a resume that gets MORE interviews ✍️
description:
If you want to get hired in this job market, your resume needs to read that you're qualified for the specific job, not any job. This is called tailoring your resume and it’s all about using specific language from the job description as you showcase experience on your resume. Check out Matching Mode in the resume builder for extra assistance. #resumebuilder #resumetips #resume  #resumebullets #jobsearchtips
